name: server-core-cpp
note: C++ game server core + vendored native libs (protobuf, log4cpp, libcurl, lua). syft will catch what has a manifest; the vendored copies without one need the native-dependencies.csv pass instead.

name: server-web-php
note: PHP backend — has composer.json/.lock, should SBOM cleanly.

name: server-gm-java
note: Java microservices platform (fosol / open-capacity-platform / xxl-job) — this is the bulk of the newly-discovered 'management plane'.

name: server-gm-dotnet
note: .NET GM tooling (LOT_WOD, ApiUpload) — has .sln/.csproj, should SBOM cleanly via syft's dotnet cataloguer.

name: infra-tools-go
note: Go utilities (process_db_seed, shengqu_source_import, vm_app_installer) — has go.mod/go.sum, should SBOM cleanly.

name: client-shelter
platform: android+ios (Unity — same C# layer ships to both; see note)
note: syft will catch whatever Unity package manifest (Packages/manifest.json) and any NuGet-style deps exist. It will NOT resolve the real Android Gradle dependency graph or iOS CocoaPods/SPM graph for the exported native projects if those are built separately from this source tree — if Android/iOS export projects with their own Podfile.lock / build.gradle exist elsewhere, add them as their own layers (client-android, client-ios) pointed at those exported projects instead of guessing from the Unity source alone.
